description: Read a coding task started through codes.task.start: GET /api/v1/tasks/:id on OpenVibe.Codes, as the service that started it, naming the same person in X-OV-Subject. Another service's task, or another person's, is 404. The answer is codes.task@2: the task itself (as codes.task@1, with the same fields at the top level) and, added to it, the task's attempts (its timeline) and its outcome.
